lines: Tomorrow I'll love you even more than today
Even now I love you this much, and yet
I can't put it into words
The days you gave me keep piling up
I found my way to you
Walking close together, side by side
Giving shape to a love that lasts forever
I want to stay by your side
I love you — still not enough, but
Gently wrapped around it — that alone
Found and gathered, the "path" we walked slowly
Our meeting, in this vast world
A small event brought us together
Even on days when nothing goes right
The road home, laughing and fooling around together
That too is precious, our days
When I told you, "Let my longing reach you!"
You showed me an expression I'd never seen
We're still in the middle of our journey
It feels like it could keep going for decades
Even if that's what we become
Walking close together, side by side
Giving shape to a love that lasts forever
I want to stay by your side
I love you — still not enough, but
Even on days when nothing goes right
Tomorrow I'll smile more than today
